lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Hi, thanks for joining us today. Can you hear me okay?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Yes, I can hear you clearly, thanks for having me.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Great. So today we'll go through your platform work first, and then leave some time for your questions at the end.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I lead data platform work, most recently a Microsoft Fabric rollout across four legal entities.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Imagine a client wants to move four legal entities from Synapse to Fabric with a hard March deadline and finance is already worried about capacity costs

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: You've worked with Fabric capacities before, right?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: And how did you handle throttling when it showed up?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: We kept a twenty percent headroom buffer and split billing back out per entity.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: That's interesting, we ran into the same problem last year.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a stakeholder.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: So what I'd like to understand is how you would

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: structure the rollout plan across the four entities?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: How would you charge back Fabric costs to each legal entity?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Do you have any questions for us?
